analysis.summaryJa: think・say・imagineなどの報告表現の奥にある節でも、主語・目的語・時や場所の情報をwhの穴として尋ねられる。全体の疑問倒置は外側のdo you thinkなどで一度だけ行い、奥の節は平叙文語順を保つ。wh語が奥の節の主語になる場合は、その直前にthatを残せない点が重要である。
grammarPoints: 基本形はWH＋do you think・say・imagine＋奥の節の穴
奥の主語を尋ねる場合も内側では追加のdo倒置をしない
whが奥の節の主語ならthatを置けない
奥の目的語や時・場所の穴ではthatを省略しても残してもよい場合がある
want＋人＋toの内部でも時・人などの要素をwhで尋ねられる
visualEvidence: REPORTの箱の奥に主語・目的語・時場所の三種類の穴が描かれる
Who do you think found it?の主語穴ルートが示される
主語穴の前にthatを置く禁止パターンが赤枠で警告される
Who did you say Nora called?とWhen do you imagine the ship will arrive?が奥の穴の例として並ぶ
commonTraps: 外側と内側の両方で疑問倒置する
奥の主語whの前にthatを残す
did you sayの後ろで内側動詞も原形に戻す
want me toのような不定詞内部の穴を見落とす

questions.prompt: Who do you think ------- the anonymous complaint?
questions.translationJa: 匿名の苦情を提出したのは誰だと思いますか。
questions.explanationJa: whoが奥の節の主語なので、thinkの後はthatなしでsubmittedを続けます。

questions.prompt: What do you believe ------- causing the network delay?
questions.translationJa: 何がネットワーク遅延を引き起こしていると思いますか。
questions.explanationJa: whatが奥の節の主語でis causingに直接続くためthatやitを補いません。

questions.prompt: Which vendor did Ms. Cole say ------- the replacement parts?
questions.translationJa: どの業者が交換部品を供給したとコールさんは言いましたか。
questions.explanationJa: which vendorが奥の節の主語なので、sayの後にthatを置かずsuppliedを続けます。

questions.prompt: Who do you think the director ------- for the position?
questions.translationJa: 部長はその役職に誰を推薦したと思いますか。
questions.explanationJa: whoは奥の節の目的語で、the director recommendedという平叙文語順を保ちます。

questions.prompt: What did the technician say the update -------?
questions.translationJa: その更新で何が直ったと技術者は言いましたか。
questions.explanationJa: whatはfixedの目的語で、内側はthe update fixedの通常語順です。外側のdidだけが倒置を担います。

questions.prompt: When do you expect the audit team -------?
questions.translationJa: 監査チームはいつ到着する見込みですか。
questions.explanationJa: expect＋人＋to doの到着時をwhenで尋ね、the audit team to arriveを保ちます。

questions.prompt: Where did you say the courier ------- the package?
questions.translationJa: 配達員は荷物をどこに置いたと言いましたか。
questions.explanationJa: 外側のdid you sayの後、奥の節はthe courier leftという過去の平叙文語順です。

questions.prompt: What time do you want the driver -------?
questions.translationJa: 運転手に何時に戻ってほしいですか。
questions.explanationJa: want＋人＋to doの内部の時を尋ねるためthe driver to returnを使います。

questions.prompt: Which office do you imagine the company will ------- next?
questions.translationJa: 会社は次にどのオフィスを開設すると思いますか。
questions.explanationJa: which officeは奥のwill openの目的語で、willの後は原形openです。
questions.focus: 奥の助動詞節の目的語

questions.prompt: Who did the witness claim ------- responsible for the damage?
questions.translationJa: 損傷の責任者は誰だと目撃者は主張しましたか。
questions.explanationJa: whoが奥のbe文の主語なのでclaimの直後にthatを置かずwas responsibleとします。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct question asking for the embedded subject.

choices.A: Who do you think that approved the refund?
choices.B: Who do you think did approve the refund?
choices.C: Who do you think did he approve the refund?
choices.D: Who do you think approved the refund?

questions.translationJa: 返金を承認したのは誰だと思いますか。
questions.explanationJa: whoがapprovedの主語なのでthinkの後にthatも内側のdidも置きません。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct question asking for the embedded object.

choices.A: What do you think did the customer order?
choices.B: What do you think the customer ordered?
choices.C: What do you think the customer did ordered?
choices.D: What do you think that did the customer order?

questions.translationJa: 顧客は何を注文したと思いますか。
questions.explanationJa: whatはorderedの目的語で、奥はthe customer orderedという平叙文語順です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct question about an embedded arrival time.

choices.A: When do you suppose will the guests arrive?
choices.B: When do you suppose do the guests arrive?
choices.C: When do you suppose the guests will arrive?
choices.D: When you suppose the guests will arrive?

questions.translationJa: 来客はいつ到着すると思いますか。
questions.explanationJa: 倒置は外側のdo you supposeだけで、内側はthe guests will arriveの順です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct question about who discovered an error.

choices.A: Who did Ms. Tran say found the error?
choices.B: Who did Ms. Tran say that found the error?
choices.C: Who did Ms. Tran say did find the error?
choices.D: Who did Ms. Tran say he found the error?

questions.translationJa: 誰が誤りを見つけたとトランさんは言いましたか。
questions.explanationJa: whoが奥の節の主語であるためsayの後にthatを残せません。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct question about an embedded destination.

choices.A: Where do you believe was the shipment sent?
choices.B: Where do you believe did the shipment send?
choices.C: Where you do believe the shipment was sent?
choices.D: Where do you believe the shipment was sent?

questions.translationJa: 荷物はどこへ送られたと思いますか。
questions.explanationJa: 外側だけdoで倒置し、内側はthe shipment was sentという受動の通常語順です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct question with “want + person + to.”

choices.A: What time do you want do we call?
choices.B: What time do you want us call to?
choices.C: What time do you want us to call?
choices.D: What time you want us to call?

questions.translationJa: 私たちに何時に電話してほしいですか。
questions.explanationJa: want us to callという構造の時情報をwhat timeで前に出します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct question asking which proposal became final.

choices.A: Which proposal do you think that became the final plan?
choices.B: Which proposal do you think became the final plan?
choices.C: Which proposal do you think did become the final plan?
choices.D: Which proposal do you think it became the final plan?

questions.translationJa: どの提案が最終案になったと思いますか。
questions.explanationJa: which proposalがbecameの主語なのでthatや代名詞itを補いません。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct question about an embedded recipient.

choices.A: Who did the manager say did Ms. Wu contact?
choices.B: Who did the manager say Ms. Wu did contacted?
choices.C: Who did the manager say that contacted Ms. Wu?
choices.D: Who did the manager say Ms. Wu contacted?

questions.translationJa: ウーさんは誰に連絡したと部長は言いましたか。
questions.explanationJa: whoはcontactedの目的語で、内側はMs. Wu contactedの順です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct question about a cause inside a report.

choices.A: What do you imagine that caused the temperature change?
choices.B: What do you imagine did cause the temperature change?
choices.C: What do you imagine caused the temperature change?
choices.D: What do you imagine it caused the temperature change?

questions.translationJa: 何が温度変化を引き起こしたと思いますか。
questions.explanationJa: whatがcausedの主語になるためthatなしで動詞に直結します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct question about a future selection.

choices.A: Which candidate do you expect the panel to select?
choices.B: Which candidate do you expect will the panel select?
choices.C: Which candidate do you expect the panel selects to?
choices.D: Which candidate you expect the panel to select?

questions.translationJa: 審査員会はどの候補者を選ぶ見込みですか。
questions.explanationJa: expect＋the panel＋to selectの目的語をwhich candidateで尋ねます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to “Who do you think sent the reminder?”

choices.A: The speaker asks for the person believed to have sent the reminder.
choices.B: The speaker asks who received the reminder.
choices.D: The speaker asks when the reminder arrived.

questions.translationJa: 話し手は誰が催促を送ったと思うか尋ねています。
questions.explanationJa: whoは奥のsentの主語で、送信者を求めます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to “What did you say the client needed?”

choices.A: The client says nothing is needed.
choices.B: The speaker asks when the client called.
choices.C: The speaker asks for the thing previously described as necessary for the client.
choices.D: The speaker asks who spoke to the client.

questions.translationJa: 話し手は顧客に必要だと言った物を尋ねています。
questions.explanationJa: whatは奥のneededの目的語で、必要な物を求めます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to “Where do you suppose the files were moved?”

choices.A: The files have not been moved.
choices.B: The speaker asks for the presumed new location of the files.
choices.C: The speaker asks why the files were deleted.
choices.D: The speaker asks who created the files.

questions.translationJa: 話し手はファイルがどこへ移されたと思うか尋ねています。
questions.explanationJa: whereが奥の受動節の場所情報を求めます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to “When do you expect the repairs to finish?”

choices.A: The speaker asks who performs the repairs.
choices.B: The speaker asks for the expected completion time of the repairs.
choices.D: The speaker asks how the repairs are performed.

questions.translationJa: 話し手は修理の完了見込み時期を尋ねています。
questions.explanationJa: whenはexpectの目的語構造内の完了時を求めます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to “Which unit do you believe failed first?”

choices.A: The speaker asks which unit was repaired first.
choices.C: The speaker asks for the unit believed to have failed before the others.
choices.D: The speaker asks who owns the units.

questions.translationJa: 話し手はどの装置が最初に故障したと思うか尋ねています。
questions.explanationJa: which unitが奥のfailedの主語となり、候補から特定させます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to “Who did you say the director promoted?”

choices.A: The director has not been promoted.
choices.B: The speaker asks for the person said to have received the promotion.
choices.C: The speaker asks who promoted the director.
choices.D: The speaker asks where the director works.

questions.translationJa: 話し手は部長が誰を昇進させたと言ったか尋ねています。
questions.explanationJa: whoは奥のpromotedの目的語で、昇進した人を求めます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to “What do you think is in the crate?”

choices.B: The speaker asks who owns the crate.
choices.C: The speaker asks where the crate was sent.
choices.D: The speaker asks for the believed contents of the crate.

questions.translationJa: 話し手は木箱の中に何があると思うか尋ねています。
questions.explanationJa: whatが奥のisの主語となり、内容物を求めます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to “What time do you want me to return?”

choices.A: The speaker asks why a return is necessary.
choices.C: The listener asks who will return.
choices.D: The speaker asks for the desired return time.

questions.translationJa: 話し手は何時に戻ってほしいかを尋ねています。
questions.explanationJa: what timeがwant me to returnの内部の時の穴を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to “Who does Ms. Park imagine will lead the project?”

choices.A: Ms. Park has refused to join the project.
choices.B: The speaker asks for Ms. Park’s expected project leader.
choices.C: The speaker asks whom the leader will contact.

questions.translationJa: 話し手はパクさんが誰をプロジェクトリーダーと予想するか尋ねています。
questions.explanationJa: whoが奥のwill leadの主語で、予想される担当者を求めます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to “Why do you think the invoice was rejected?”

choices.A: The speaker asks for the believed reason for rejection.
choices.C: The speaker asks who printed the invoice.
choices.D: The speaker asks where the invoice is stored.

questions.translationJa: 話し手は請求書が却下された理由をどう考えるか尋ねています。
questions.explanationJa: whyが奥の受動節の理由情報を求めます。

questions.prompt: Security footage shows someone entering after midnight. Who do you think ------- the side door?
questions.translationJa: 防犯映像には深夜に誰かが入る様子があります。誰が脇の扉を開けたと思いますか。
questions.explanationJa: whoが奥のopenedの主語なのでthatやdidを置きません。
questions.focus: 証拠から尋ねる奥主語

questions.prompt: The customer mentioned a missing item, but I did not hear its name. What did she say the package -------?
questions.translationJa: 顧客は不足品に触れましたが名称が聞こえませんでした。荷物に何が足りないと言いましたか。
questions.explanationJa: whatは奥のlackedの目的語で、内側はthe package lackedの通常語順です。

questions.prompt: The train may be delayed, and our pickup driver needs an estimate. When do you expect it -------?
questions.translationJa: 列車が遅れる可能性があり、迎えの運転手に見込みが必要です。いつ到着する見込みですか。
questions.explanationJa: expect it to arriveの時をwhenで尋ねます。

questions.prompt: The audit found an unexplained payment. Which department do you believe ------- it?
questions.translationJa: 監査で説明のない支払いが見つかりました。どの部署が承認したと思いますか。
questions.explanationJa: which departmentが奥の主語なのでthatなしでauthorizedを続けます。

questions.prompt: We know the courier moved the crate, but the new location is not recorded. Where did he say he ------- it?
questions.translationJa: 配達員が木箱を動かしたことは分かりますが新しい場所が未記録です。どこに置いたと言いましたか。
questions.explanationJa: 外側のdid he sayに続く奥の節はhe placedという通常語順です。

questions.prompt: The agency can arrange a pickup, but it needs our preferred hour. What time do we want the driver -------?
questions.translationJa: 代理店は集荷を手配できますが希望時刻が必要です。運転手に何時に来てほしいですか。
questions.explanationJa: want the driver to comeの時をwhat timeで尋ねます。

questions.prompt: Several factors may explain the outage. What do the engineers think ------- the main cause?
questions.translationJa: 停止には複数の要因が考えられます。技術者は何が主因だったと考えていますか。
questions.explanationJa: whatが奥のwasの主語なので代名詞itやthatを補いません。

questions.prompt: The board approved one of four sites. Which site did the chair say the company -------?
questions.translationJa: 取締役会は4候補のうち1か所を承認しました。会社はどこを選んだと議長は言いましたか。
questions.explanationJa: which siteは奥のselectedの目的語で、the company selectedの語順です。

questions.prompt: A revised policy will take effect, but the announcement omits the date. When do you imagine it will -------?
questions.translationJa: 改訂方針が施行されますが発表に日付がありません。いつ始まると思いますか。
questions.explanationJa: 奥のwillの後ろは原形beginで、whenが時の穴を示します。

questions.prompt: The complaint says a staff member made the promise. Who did the customer claim ------- responsible?
questions.translationJa: 苦情には職員が約束したとあります。誰に責任があると顧客は主張しましたか。
questions.explanationJa: whoが奥のwas responsibleの主語なのでthatを入れずwasを続けます。
